mesh.role: decimated surface that rendered the training views (face count verified against render_meta.json)

normalization.source_axis: COLMAP world frame (the STL frame the renderer used)
normalization.note: points and rotations mapped by R^T and translation; scales shifted by -log(s). No viewer-frame R_y(-90) is applied here, so distances are measured in the original STL frame.

caveat: Cloud→mesh is exact point-to-triangle distance against the decimated training mesh. Mesh→cloud uses 120,000 deterministic area-weighted samples of that same mesh. Appearance in training was a synthetic height/facing material rendered from this geometry, not a patient photograph.
